item.title: Giving silence a seat at the virtual table
item.description: “Silence spoken here.” I first read this phrase in reference to the Abbey of Gethsemani, the Trappist monastery in Kentucky. Silence has been spoken there for more than 175 years. It has been spoken in the Christian tradition for millennia more.

item.title: After ICE raids Ramadan in Minnesota is somber but some hope it offers healing
item.description: For many Muslims in the Twin Cities, Ramadan feels somber after the federal immigration enforcement surge left many immigrant families wary of gathering. But those some are hoping the Islamic sacred month of fasting and charity, which began last week, will offer a sense of communal grounding and healing.
